title: 01  System Use Cases · Overview
subtitle: The system boundary includes Vue, the Express query service, and both smart contracts. One wallet may fulfill several roles.

title: 02  Market Use Cases · Details
subtitle: Precondition: a wallet on the target chain. Sellers own the NFT; bidders do not. Withdrawal requires a pending balance.

title: 03  Overall Usage and Transaction Confirmation
subtitle: Activity diagram · Public browsing needs no wallet. Minting, trading, bidding, transfers, and administration use on-chain transactions.

title: 04  Connect and Disconnect a Wallet
subtitle: Activity diagram · MetaMask or local demo accounts. Demo mode requires localhost / 127.0.0.1 and Hardhat chain 31337.

title: 05  Mint NFTs
subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: wallet connected to the target chain. NetPunks performs final validation and issuance.

title: 06  List, Reprice, and Cancel a Listing
subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: current NFT holder. Listing and bid acceptance request single-token approval only when needed.

title: 07  Buy an NFT at the Listed Price
subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: connected buyer is not the seller. A private listing requires the designated buyer address.

title: 08  Place, Raise, and Withdraw a Bid
subtitle: Activity diagram · One highest bid per minted NFT. Full ETH escrow is held by the market; holders cannot bid on their own NFT.

title: 09  Accept the Highest Bid
subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: current holder's wallet, an active highest bid, and approval for the market to transfer the NFT.

title: 10  Withdraw Market Funds
subtitle: Activity diagram · Entry: My Collection. Market proceeds and refunded bids accumulate in pendingWithdrawals.

title: 11  Transfer an NFT
subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: current holder's wallet. A gift transfer uses ERC-721 safeTransferFrom directly.

title: 12  Mint Administration and Proceeds
subtitle: Activity diagram · Precondition: NetPunks owner wallet. The contract enforces onlyOwner in addition to the frontend gate.

title: 13  NetPunks contract flowchart
subtitle: Each panel is an independent function flow, not a sequential or parallel stage. Checks, effects and rollback follow the current source.

subtitle: Each panel is an independent function flow, not a sequential or parallel stage. Checks, effects and rollback follow the current source.
